workflow.critical: Execute ALL steps in exact order

step.goal: Resolve suite name from argument or active suite in test-suites.yml

check.if: no suite name argument is provided
file does not exist or active_suite is empty
check.output: ❌ No active suite found. Run /aiqa-analyzestory --suite <name> first.

step.action: Find the suite entry where name = {suite_name}

check.output: ⚠️ Suite status is "{current_status}" — E2E files may not have been generated yet. Continuing validation; artifact checks will catch missing files.

step.goal: Load E2E artifacts and expected AC count
step.action: Read ALL story files in {story_files}; count {expected_ac_count} = total unique ACs

Record expected artifact paths: - Page Object: {output_folder}/{story_id}/e2e/pages/{suite_name}.page.js - Spec file: {output_folder}/{story_id}/e2e/tests/{suite_name}.spec.js - Checklist: {output_folder}/{story_id}/test-checklist.md
If spec exists: read it completely; extract all page.goto() URLs; count test() blocks
If page object exists: read it completely

step.goal: Run all quality checks and collect issues
step.check: Both .page.js and .spec.js files exist at the correct paths INSIDE {output_folder}/{story_id}/e2e/ — FAIL if files are in any host project folder

Every URL path in page.goto() calls is a valid, reachable route: a. Extract all unique paths from page.goto() calls b. Cross-reference against routes.pages in project.config.json c. For any path not found: read host project router files to verify d. Flag paths that cannot be verified as correct
Spec covers ALL {expected_ac_count} acceptance criteria — at minimum one positive test() per AC
Each AC has at least one negative test case (invalid input, missing field, auth failure)
No hardcoded base URLs in page.goto() — must use baseURL from Playwright config or config.yaml
Each test() block contains at least one meaningful expect() assertion — not just navigation
Page Object file uses JavaScript (not TypeScript) — no type annotations, no interface/type keywords, no .ts extension
Page Object constructor accepts page parameter and assigns this.page = page
All locators use this.page.locator() or Playwright locator methods — no raw strings outside locator calls
Spec file imports Page Object using a relative path pointing to the pages/ folder
Spec uses test.describe and individual test() blocks — not bare function calls
No page.waitForTimeout() with arbitrary millisecond delays — use waitForSelector() or expect().toBeVisible() instead

step.goal: Present validation report and ask how to proceed

check.output:
✅ Validation Passed — /aiqa-generatee2e
All 12 quality checks passed. E2E files are correct and complete. Suite: {suite_name} | ACs covered: {expected_ac_count} No issues found — safe to proceed to /aiqa-generatetestdata.

step.output:
╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗ ║ 🔍 Validation Report — /aiqa-generatee2e ║ ╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
Suite : {suite_name} Files : {output_folder}/{story_id}/e2e/ ACs expected: {expected_ac_count}
🔴 Critical ({critical_count}): (for each Critical issue: " • {id} — {description}" + detail) (if none: " None")
🟠 High ({high_count}): (for each High issue: " • {id} — {description}" + detail) (if none: " None")
🟡 Medium ({medium_count}): (for each Medium issue: " • {id} — {description}") (if none: " None")
🔵 Low ({low_count}): (if none: " None")
Total issues: {total_issues}
step.ask: How would you like to proceed? A) Fix ALL {total_issues} issue(s) — resolve every finding B) Fix only Critical + High ({critical_count + high_count} issue(s)) — skip Medium and Low C) Skip — keep the report, apply no fixes

step.action: Determine issues to fix: Choice A → fix ALL issues Choice B → fix only Critical and High issues

For each issue selected for fixing: E2E-1 → if files missing: re-run /aiqa-generatee2e {suite_name} to regenerate; if in wrong location: move to correct path E2E-2 → convert any TypeScript syntax to plain JavaScript (remove type annotations, interfaces, .ts references) E2E-3 → fix POM constructor: ensure it accepts page and assigns this.page = page E2E-4 → replace any raw CSS selector strings outside locator calls with proper this.page.locator() calls E2E-5 → fix import path in spec to use relative path ../pages/{suite_name}.page.js E2E-6 → wrap test functions inside test.describe block; convert bare calls to test() blocks E2E-7 → for each AC not covered: add a positive test() block targeting that specific AC's behavior E2E-8 → for each AC lacking a negative test: add a test() with invalid/rejected input and assertion for the error state E2E-9 → replace hardcoded full base URLs with baseURL reference from Playwright config E2E-10 → replace page.waitForTimeout(N) with appropriate: await expect(locator).toBeVisible() or await page.waitForSelector() E2E-11 → add at least one expect() assertion to each test that has none E2E-12 → for each unrecognized URL path: read host project router files to find correct route; update spec with verified path Save both .page.js and .spec.js after all edits.

step.goal: Re-verify fixed checks and report final status
step.action: Re-run ONLY the checks that were targeted for fixing
step.output:
📋 Validation Summary — /aiqa-generatee2e
(for each fixed check:) ✅ {id} — resolved: {what was corrected} (for each still failing:) ❌ {id} — still failing: {reason} (for each skipped check:) ⏭️ {id} — skipped (outside selected fix scope)
(if all targeted checks pass:) ✅ All targeted issues resolved. Safe to proceed to /aiqa-generatetestdata.
(if some still fail:) ⚠️ {remaining} issue(s) could not be fixed automatically. Edit the E2E files manually, then re-run /aiqa-generatee2e-validate.
